Election/Town Meeting Information
All Elections and Town Meetings are held from 7:00am-8:00pm at the
Hubbardston
Center School Gym at 8 Elm Street (
Hubbardston's
polling location). Voter parking is located behind the gym, with entrance at 7 Main Street.
Elections/Town Meetings in Hubbardston during the year 2026:
1)
Annual Town Meeting -
According to Chapter II, Section 1c of Hubbardston's General Bylaws, "The part of the Annual Town Meeting for the conduct of business matters shall be held at 7:30 PM on the Monday of the week preceding the Annual Town Election or such other date prior to the end of the fiscal year as designated by the Select Board."
2)
Annual Town Election - second Tuesday in June from 7:00AM to 8:00PM
- According to Chapter II, Section 1c of Hubbardston's General Bylaws, "That part of the Annual Town Meeting for the election of Town Officers and the determination of such matters as the laws that are required to be determined by ballot shall be held on the second Tuesday in June each year."
3)
State Primaries - Tuesday, September 1, 2026
. Information on registration deadlines and voting by mail/early voting can be found here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/recent-updates/upcoming-elections.htm
4)
Special Town Meeting
- Tuesday, October 27 at 7:00PM at Hubbardston Center School gym (more info below)
- Warrant available here:
https://www.hubbardstonma.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Agenda/_10272026-834
5)
State Election - Tuesday, November 3, 2026
. Information on registration deadlines and voting by mail/early voting can be found here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/recent-updates/upcoming-elections.htm
- warrant can be viewed here:

- sample ballot for November 3, 2026 State Election can be found here:

Notice of Early Voting Hours
______________________________________________________________
Massachusetts Voter Information can be found here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/elections-and-voting.htm
Information on Registering to Vote can be found here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voter-resources/registering-to-vote.htm
______________________________________________________________
Information on Upcoming Town Meetings and Elections:
There will be a Special Fall Town Meeting on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 7:00PM at the Hubbardston Center School gym. The warrant for the Special Town Meeting will close September 21, 2026, and the warrant will be posted on or before October 13, 2026 (at least 14 days before town meeting, per Town bylaws).
From Hubbardston's General Bylaws: "Chapter II, SECTION 2. Notice of Meetings - In accordance with General Laws, notice of all Town Meetings shall be given by posting attested copies of the Warrant therefor in the Town Office, and two other public places, and through a general mailing to all Boxholders in the Town of Hubbardston fourteen (14) days at least prior to either a Special or Annual Town Meeting, such posting to be done by a constable or if no constable is available, by a police officer. Town Meeting warrants shall also be posted on the official Town of Hubbardston website and any official social media outlets at least fourteen (14) days prior to either a Special or Annual Town Meeting."
Absentee Ballot application and information is available here
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voting-information/absentee-voting.htm
and the application is also available here:
Absentee Ballot Application
. Vote by mail was available for the Annual Town Election, and you can apply to vote by mail here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/languages/vote-by-mail-applications.htm
or print the application here:
Vote by Mail paper application
. You can use this application to sign up for vote by mail for all the elections this year.
Early Voting In-Person and Voting by Mail Information
:
Avoid the Crowds, Vote by Mail or Early In-Person
It is now required that towns/cities offer early voting in-person and vote by mail for most elections.
In-person early voting must be offered for all regular state primaries, state elections, and presidential primaries. In-person Early Voting for State and Presidential Primaries will be offered during various times/hours from the 10th day before through the 4th day before a primary. In-person Early Voting for State/General Elections will be offered during various days/hours from the 17th day before through the 4th day before a State election. Early Voting By Mail is now required for all elections, including local elections, unless the Select Board opts out. Early in-person voting will be available at local elections if the Board of Registrars opts in.
Information about when early voting is available for upcoming state primaries and elections can be found here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/recent-updates/upcoming-elections.htm
Vote by Mail Information:
The Town Clerk's Office must receive your application for Vote by Mail by 5:00PM on the 5th business day before the election. No matter when the application is postmarked, your application must be at the local election office by the deadline. Apply as early as possible, especially if your ballot will need to be mailed out of town. The Postal Service recommends allowing up to 7 days for mail delivery. To ensure that you receive your ballot with enough time to mail it back, you should apply 2-3 weeks before Election Day.
You can mail your application to Town Clerk's Office, 48 Gardner Rd, Unit 12, Hubbardston, MA, 01452 or drop it in the green, metal drop box located at 48 Gardner Rd, directly outside the Town Clerk's office.
You can also apply online here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/MailInRequestWeb/MailInBallot.aspx
Track your mail-in ballot's status here
or by clicking this link
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/WhereDoIVoteMA/TrackMyBallot
***For State Elections Only***
, the Town Clerk's Office needs to receive your ballot by the 3rd day after the election for State elections, and it needs to be postmarked the date of the Election (not after), in order to be counted as a valid ballot
IN-PERSON Early Voting:
Please be reminded that the Town Clerk's office - during the early voting time period - is a polling place, and therefore no campaigning or campaign signs/apparel that are pertinent to the current election are permitted in the voting area, which includes an area 150' from the entrance to the Town Clerk's office. In-person early voting and in-person absentee voting takes place at the Town Clerk's office (48 Gardner Road, right side of the building, 2nd door).
In-person early voting hours for November 3, 2026 State Election will be held at the Town Clerk's office (48 Gardner Road) as follows:
Saturday, October 17 from 9:00AM-5:00PM
Monday, October 19 from 8:00AM-4:00PM
Tuesday, October 20 from 8:00AM-6:00PM
Wednesday, October 21 from 8:00AM-4:00PM
Thursday, October 22 from 8:00AM-4:00PM
Saturday, October 24 (last day to register to vote for State Election) from 9:00AM-5:00PM
Monday, October 26 from 8:00AM-4:00PM
Tuesday, October 27 from 8:00AM-5:00PM (Special Town Meeting at 7:00PM, so the office is closing at 5:00PM)
Wednesday, October 28 from 8:00AM-4:00PM
Thursday, October 29 from 8:00AM-4:00PM
Information on Registering to vote:
Voter registration information is available here:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voter-resources/registering-to-vote.htm
In order to register to vote in Hubbardston you must be:
A U.S. Citizen
A resident of Hubbardston
At least 18 years of age on or before the next election
You may register to vote in person at the Town Clerk’s Office during regular business hours, through the Registry of Motor Vehicles, through various other State Agencies, or by completing a mail-in registration affidavit and returning it to our office. A new Online Voter Registration option has been added as of July 2015 (
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voter-resources/registering-to-vote.htm
). To request a mail-in registration card, contact the Town Clerk’s Office at (978) 928-1400, extension 202 or email
[email protected]
. A valid Massachusetts Driver's License number or the last four digits of your Social Security Number must be provided on the voter registration affidavit. You must choose either a party enrollment or you may choose “No Party" (Unenrolled, which is commonly referred to as "Independent"). After the affidavit has been processed and verified by the State Voter Information System (VRIS) as complete, an acknowledgment letter will be generated and sent to you to confirm your registration and inform you of your polling location. Please notify the Town Clerk’s office if your address changes within the Town of Hubbardston. If you move to another town or city in Massachusetts, you must re-register to vote in that community.
*****Registration Deadline:
New voter registrations must be received ten (10) days prior to all primaries, elections, and town meetings.*****
Information for Candidates, or People Interested in Running for Town Offices:
If you're interested in running for an open office on the ballot, information will be posted in 2027 about deadlines and nomination paper requirements.
Deadline to apply for nomination papers for Annual Town Election this year was April 21, 2026.
Information for Candidates:
Campaign Finance/Filing Requirements for Campaign Finance Reports
- All candidates for municipal office, including all incumbent elected officials, are required to file 3 campaign finance reports. The first is due 8 days prior to the election, the second is due 30 days after the election, and the third is a year-end report due on January 20. The same requirements also apply to all active campaign/ballot question committees.  According to the campaign finance law, you must file a year-end report on Form CPF M102 with this office on or before January 20th. The reporting period covers the day after your last report through December 31 of the year of the election you ran in. If you did not receive any contributions, make any expenditures, or incur any liabilities during this reporting period, and you do not have a previous campaign balance, you have the option of signing an M102-0 affidavit form stating those facts. You may download the form online and send it to the Town Clerk, or come into the office to sign. Additional forms are available online through the Office of Campaign Finance if needed. Please call with any questions, or refer to Mass. General Law Chapter 55 for details on campaign finance law and associated penalties.
Any questions, please contact Melody Green, Town Clerk at
[email protected]
, stop in the office (located at 48 Gardner Road), or call 978-928-1400, extension 202.
